club.name: North Star Ridebook
club.description: A shared ride board for people who want one place to join the crew, trade routes, post ride photos, and keep the club journal moving.

members.name: Marisol Vega
members.bio: Weeknight river loops, bakery stops on Saturdays, and a low tolerance for headwinds without coffee.

members.name: Theo Johnson
members.bio: Commutes year-round and posts route notes every time the pavement changes.

members.name: Amina Yusuf
members.bio: Brings new riders into the group and always knows where the calmest trail entry is.

routes.title: Mississippi sunrise loop
routes.notes: Early morning river light, smooth warm-up, and enough turns to keep it interesting without getting hectic.

routes.title: Greenway shakeout to Bde Maka Ska
routes.notes: Great for newer riders. Mostly forgiving pace with an easy lake lap once the group settles in.

routes.title: Northside gravel connector
routes.notes: Pavement into short gravel stretches. Best when the river trail is dry and the group wants a longer pull.

photos.caption: Cold river air, soft orange light, and just enough traffic noise to remind you this is still the city.
A quick regroup before the lake lap when the pace settled and everyone finally unclipped to talk.
Dust on the frame, sun coming through the trees, and a route that felt longer in the best way.

posts.title: Test Post
posts.body: We went through the Minnehaha Falls today.

posts.title: Saturday social rides need clearer regroup points
posts.body: The route worked, but new riders had trouble knowing where the first full regroup would happen. Next time we should note two obvious landmarks in the route post so nobody has to guess whether they should keep pushing or soft pedal.

posts.title: Rain route fallback for weekday spins
posts.body: When the streets are slick, the lower-traffic river option is still good, but the club should pin one short fallback loop for commuters who want a predictable thirty to forty minutes without debating conditions in the group chat.

posts.title: Volunteer ride for trail cleanup
posts.body: A ride-to-cleanup format would fit this group well: meet at the bridge, spin to the work site, spend an hour helping out, then head to coffee after. This space can double as the planning board for those kinds of club days.
